preconditions.description: Input x must be a string.
Length of x must be between 1 and 32000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == all((x.count('{') == x.count('}')) and (x.count('(') == x.count(')')) and (x.count('[') == x.count(']')))
postconditions.description: The counts of each type of opening and closing bracket must be equal.

postconditions.expression: return_value == all((x[i] == '{' and x[j] == '}') or (x[i] == '(' and x[j] == ')') or (x[i] == '[' and x[j] == ']') for i in range(len(x)) for j in range(i + 1, len(x)) if x[i] in '({[' and x[j] in ')}]') and all((x[i] == '{' and x[j] == '}') or (x[i] == '(' and x[j] == ')') or (x[i] == '[' and x[j] == ']') for i in range(len(x)) for j in range(i + 1, len(x)) if x[i] in ')}]' and x[j] in '({['))
postconditions.description: Every opening bracket must have a corresponding closing bracket of the same type, and they must be properly nested.
